title: A single-molecule magnet assembly exhibiting a dielectric transition at 470 K

material_class.structural_family: triangular Dy3 single-molecule magnet with toroidal local-moment alignment

synthesis.procedure: Dy(NO3)3·6H2O (0.5 mmol, 228.3 mg) was slowly added to a 20 mL ethanol solution containing H4L (N,N,N',N'-tetrakis(2-hydroxyethyl)ethylenediamine; 1.0 mmol, 273 mg) and LiOH (0.4 mmol, 16.8 mg). After stirring for two hours the mixture was transferred to a vial and heated under solvothermal conditions. Colorless crystals of pure phase (microscope selection and PXRD) were obtained.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Colorless crystals formed directly and were confirmed as a pure phase by careful microscopic selection and PXRD.

properties.summary: Powder χT and magnetization, zero-field ac susceptibility, and single-crystal micro-SQUID hysteresis establish two-step SMM relaxation and a non-vanishing ground-state moment. Ab initio analysis gives Ising local moments whose dipolar and exchange couplings favor a toroidal arrangement, distinct from a non-magnetic Dy3 ground state.

measurements.name: χT
measurements.conditions: room temperature, polycrystalline powder, 0.1 T; expected 42.51 cm^3 K mol^-1 for three uncoupled Dy(III)

measurements.name: χT
measurements.conditions: minimum at 2 K, 0.1 T, after a gradual decrease to 20 K

measurements.name: saturation magnetization
measurements.conditions: 2 K, 5 T; expected 15.7 μB for three free Dy(III) ions

measurements.name: effective energy barrier (fast relaxation)
measurements.conditions: zero dc field; Arrhenius fit of χ'' over 3–9 K; τ0 = 1.0×10^-6 s

measurements.name: effective energy barrier (slow relaxation)
measurements.conditions: zero dc field; Arrhenius fit of χ'' over 6–22 K; τ0 = 5.8×10^-7 s

measurements.name: Ising exchange J12
measurements.conditions: J = Jdip + Jexch; Jexch = 1.608, Jdip = 5.428 cm^-1

measurements.name: ground Kramers doublet gZ
measurements.conditions: Dy1, Dy2, Dy3 lowest doublets; gX/gY near zero

measurements.name: magnetic hysteresis
measurements.conditions: single-crystal micro-SQUID; coercivity increases on cooling and with faster field sweep rates; steps near −1.0 T and other crossings
